bullets: Huge military exercises are underway off and around Britain's coast, involving 13,000 personnel from 14 countries.

slides.title: Background on Joint Warrior Exercises
bullets: For more than a year, NATO has been condemning Russia's actions in Ukraine and its frequent, large-scale, snap military drills.

slides.speaker_notes: The Joint Warrior exercises are a response to Russia's aggressive behavior in Ukraine and its frequent military drills. The exercises are a demonstration of NATO's commitment to providing security to its member states.

slides.title: Competitive Elements in Joint Warrior Exercises

slides.title: Russia's Interest in Joint Warrior Exercises

Huge military exercises are underway off and around Britain's coast, but NATO insists they are not a deliberate response to the Russian military's increasingly brazen behavior.

The British-led war games are code named Joint Warrior and the numbers are all big: 13,000 personnel from 14 countries operating more than 50 ships and submarines as well as 70 aircraft.

NATO says the planning started long before Russia began behaving as an adversary.
